screen.skygrid.config.title: Sky Grid
screen.skygrid.config.filter.tooltip: Hide blocks that are not in the current dimension pool.
screen.skygrid.config.dimension.tooltip: Each dimension has its own block pool.
screen.skygrid.config.hint: %s blocks in the %s pool · new chunks only
command.skygrid.help.line1: /skygrid blocks [log] [dim]  ·  reload  ·  add/remove/weight  ·  tag add/remove  ·  chance [type] [0-1] [dim]
command.skygrid.help.line2: /skygridgui opens the block editor. Changes only affect newly generated chunks.
command.skygrid.status.not_skygrid: This dedicated server is not using Sky Grid. Set level-type=skygrid:skygrid in server.properties before generating the world.
command.skygrid.reload.success: All dimension configs reloaded. Pools rebuild on next chunk generation.
command.skygrid.chunk_note: Applies to newly generated chunks only — existing terrain is unchanged.
command.skygrid.add.noop: %s is already in the %s pool with weight %s — nothing to do.
command.skygrid.weight.missing: %s is not in the %s pool. Use /skygrid add first.
command.skygrid.weight.noop: %s already has weight %s in %s — nothing to do.
command.skygrid.unknown_block: No such block: %s — it is not registered. Check the mod is installed.
command.skygrid.unknown_dimension: Unknown dimension '%s' — expected overworld, nether or end.
command.skygrid.tag.add.empty: That tag currently matches nothing. Kept anyway — it will apply if a mod defining it is installed later.
command.skygrid.blocks.more: Showing first %s of %s — use /skygrid blocks log [dimension] for the full list
command.skygrid.blocks.log.ok: Full list dumped to the game log.
command.skygrid.chance.noop: %s chance in %s is already %s (%s%%) — nothing to do.
command.skygrid.chance.unknown: Unknown chance type '%s' — expected spawner, chest or cluster.
